summary: The pale clapboard, forest-green sash, gray-green roof palette, and elongated dormitory form are coherent and recognizable, but the model suppresses the building’s most characteristic veranda architecture and oversimplifies its roof/annex silhouette.

orientation.summary: The map assigns the NE/Pratt end to -u. Located SV2 views that face head-on from the NE and shows a centered walk and stairs rising to the sheltered porch; the -u render and door inventory correspond with one centered green principal door. Conversely, located SV1 shows the SW/Wythe +u end with multiple subordinate doors beneath the shared veranda, matching the inventory’s two +u doors rather than a duplicated principal portal.

issues.problem: The signature two-level veranda is largely missing or reduced to tiny end balconies. SV1 shows prominent white posts, brackets, and dense upper rails at +u, while SV3 shows an extensive two-story porch along +v; the model instead presents broad, flat window walls.
issues.fix: Add a clearly legible two-level veranda wrapping the Wythe/+u end into the +v side, with white posts, decorative brackets, close-set railings, and doors sheltered below.

issues.problem: The long block’s roof and end massing read as an overly plain bar with bulky clipped/hipped ends, losing the aerial’s smaller roof breaks and low annex character.
issues.fix: Refine the silhouette with simpler gabled terminations, modest roof interruptions, and a visibly lower side annex while retaining caricature-scale proportions.

issues.problem: The +v and -v panels are heavily blocked by neighboring models, preventing a clean review of the target’s long elevations and veranda continuity.
issues.fix: Regenerate the four-face sheet with isolated or hidden neighboring buildings so every labeled elevation is unobstructed.
